Mapping of addresses allowed to transfer tokens; mutated by givePermissions.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address that is treated as permitted.
Token balance mapping updated by _transfer.
Nested allowance mapping written by _approve.
Fixed total supply minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Returns msg.sender; the only source of caller identity for all permission checks.
Initializes privileged addresses and seeds the _permitted mapping.
Internal function that grants transfer permission to an arbitrary address after a multi-address require.
Modifier restricting execution to one of the five hardcoded owner addresses.
Modifier restricting execution to addresses present in the _permitted mapping.
Permitted-only token transfer that also auto-grants permission to the recipient when the caller is privileged.
Allowance-based transfer that auto-grants permission to the recipient when the caller is the Uniswap router.
Deployer-only allowance setter.
Deployer-only allowance increase using SafeMath.add.
Deployer-only allowance decrease using SafeMath.sub.
Internal balance-moving routine with zero-address and balance checks.
Internal allowance-writing routine with zero-address checks.
Sends ETH with a low-level call that forwards all gas to an arbitrary recipient.
Performs an arbitrary low-level call with value to a target contract.
Caller-controlled address read through _msgSender() and used in every permission decision.
transfer() silently calls givePermissions(recipient) whenever the caller belongs to the hardcoded owner set, letting a transfer expand the allowlist.
transferFrom() calls givePermissions(recipient) whenever the caller is the Uniswap router, letting the pool address be allowlisted through a swap path.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwards all remaining gas to an attacker-controlled address before state is finalized.
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) forwards all gas to an arbitrary target contract with no reentrancy guard.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by Context._msgSender().
givePermissions compares _msgSender() against the five hardcoded privileged addresses.
onlyDeployer requires _msgSender() to equal one of the hardcoded owners.
onlyPermitted indexes _permitted with _msgSender(), a caller-controlled address.
ERC20.transfer is guarded by the onlyPermitted modifier.
ERC20.approve is guarded by the onlyDeployer modifier.
ERC20.increaseAllowance is guarded by the onlyDeployer modifier.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance is guarded by the onlyDeployer modifier.
onlyPermitted reads the _permitted mapping entry for the caller.
onlyDeployer reads the _deployer state variable.
givePermissions compares the caller against _deployer before granting a permission.
The Permissions constructor assigns the initial _deployer address.
The constructor seeds _permitted for all hardcoded addresses.
givePermissions writes _permitted[who] = true, expanding the transfer allowlist.
The who parameter is caller-supplied and becomes a newly permitted address.
transfer calls givePermissions(recipient) whenever the caller is a hardcoded owner.
The unsafe auto-grant operation invokes givePermissions on the transfer recipient.
transfer delegates balance updates to _transfer.
transfer recipient parameter flows into the transfer logic.
transfer amount parameter flows into the transfer logic.
transferFrom calls givePermissions(recipient) when the caller equals the Uniswap router.
The Uniswap-triggered auto-grant invokes givePermissions on the recipient.
transferFrom delegates balance updates to _transfer.
transferFrom decreases the allowance through _approve.
transferFrom sender parameter is debited by the internal transfer.
transferFrom recipient parameter is credited and possibly permitted.
transferFrom amount parameter drives the allowance subtraction.
_transfer subtracts from and adds to the _balances mapping.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
approve calls the internal _approve routine.
increaseAllowance calls the internal _approve routine.
decreaseAllowance calls the internal _approve routine.
approve spender parameter sets the allowance key.
approve amount parameter sets the allowance value.
addedValue parameter is added to the existing allowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the existing allowance.
Internal sender argument selects the debited balance slot.
Internal recipient argument selects the credited balance slot.
Internal amount argument drives the SafeMath sub/add on balances.
Owner argument is written as the allowance mapping key.
Spender argument is written as the allowance mapping sub-key.
Amount argument becomes the stored allowance value.
sendValue executes a low-level value call that transfers control to the recipient.
_functionCallWithValue executes a low-level call that transfers control to the target.
Recipient parameter becomes the target of the value call.
Amount parameter determines the value sent and the balance check.
Target parameter is the call destination and is checked with isContract.
Data parameter is forwarded as raw calldata to the target.
weiValue parameter is attached to the low-level call.
success local receives the boolean result of the low-level call.
returndata local receives and bubbles up the raw return bytes.
An external recipient can reenter sendValue through the low-level call before completion.
A malicious target contract can reenter _functionCallWithValue during the low-level call.
transferFrom compares _msgSender() with uniswap() to decide whether to grant permission.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender argument of _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter who is only consumed by givePermissions; fold it into that function node.
transfer recipient parameter belongs to ERC20.transfer.
transfer amount parameter belongs to ERC20.transfer.
transferFrom sender parameter belongs to ERC20.transferFrom.
transferFrom recipient parameter belongs to ERC20.transferFrom.
transferFrom amount parameter belongs to ERC20.transferFrom.
approve spender parameter belongs to ERC20.approve.
approve amount parameter belongs to ERC20.approve.
_transfer sender argument belongs to the internal _transfer routine.
_approve owner argument belongs to the internal _approve routine.
sendValue recipient parameter belongs to Address.sendValue.
sendValue amount parameter belongs to Address.sendValue.
success local is produced by the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue.
returndata local is produced by the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue.
